title: Kura skill registry
description: The skill registry for the catalog at ~/.config/kura/catalog. A skill exists for Kura only when this file names it, and its source is skills/<name>/SKILL.md; a skill directory with no entry is ignored. Entries also carry groups, dependencies, global policy and upstream sources. An entry named here whose source directory is absent stays representable so `kura list` and `kura doctor` can report it as missing.

$schema.description: URL or relative path of this schema.

version.description: Registry format version. Kura does not read it; registries using upstream and local carry 3.

upstream.description: Upstream repositories, keyed by GitHub owner/repo. Only skills listed here are targets for `kura update` and `kura outdated`.

local.description: Skills authored in the catalog itself. They have no upstream, so `kura update` leaves them alone.

upstream_path.description: Path of the skill inside the fetched repository. Empty, "." or "/" means the repository root is itself the skill. Its last component names the skill unless `name` overrides it.

skillName.description: One safe path component. It must equal the directory name under the catalog's skills/ and the `name` in that skill's SKILL.md frontmatter; a mismatch blocks installation.

groups.description: Descriptive tags, matched exactly and never normalised. The retired `global` tag is refused; use the boolean field instead.

dependencies.description: Skill names pulled in recursively whenever this skill is installed. Dependencies are never written to a project's kura.json.

globalPolicy.description: Whether this skill is a durable global root. `kura sync` links it and its recursive dependencies into every globally enabled harness. False or omission does not prevent global installation as a dependency.

dependencyOnly.description: The skill installs only as another skill's dependency and refuses `kura add` by name.

updatedAt.description: When `kura update` last replaced the skill's content. Written as %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ.
